info.title: API.SH: DEX Screener
info.description: The DEX Screener API from API.SH: public DEX Screener data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Paid orders for a token on DEX Screener (token profile, ads, community takeover) with their status and payment time, and its boosts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dexscreener-orders

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Chain id.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address (or chain/address, or a dexscreener.com link in `url`).

get.description:
Search decentralized-exchange trading pairs across chains by token name, symbol or address (up to 30 pairs): chain, DEX, pair address, base and quote tokens, price in USD and native, transactions and volume for 5 m/1 h/6 h/24 h, price change, liquidity, FDV, market cap, creation time, website and social links. Optional filters narrow the returned pairs by chain, DEX, minimum liquidity, minimum 24 h volume and maximum pair age; `count` is the number of pairs left after filtering.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dexscreener-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Token name, symbol, token address or pair address.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Keep only pairs on this chain id (e.g. solana, ethereum, bsc, base).

parameters.name: dex
parameters.description: Keep only pairs on this DEX id (e.g. raydium, uniswap, pancakeswap).

parameters.name: liquidity_min
parameters.description: Minimum liquidity in USD.

parameters.name: volume_min
parameters.description: Minimum 24 h trading volume in USD.

parameters.name: age_max
parameters.description: Maximum pair age in hours (pairs created within this many hours).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dexscreener-token

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Chain id.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Token address.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The tokens DEX Screener promotes at the top of its trending lists: the most-boosted tokens right now (source=top) or the newest boosts (source=latest), up to 30, optionally on one chain. Each token: rank, chain, address, link, boost total, description, icon, header image and social links, plus the market data of its most liquid pool (name, symbol, price, market cap, FDV, liquidity, volume, price change and transactions for 5 minutes to 24 hours, and the pool itself).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dexscreener-trending

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Only this chain, e.g. `solana`, `ethereum`, `base`, `bsc`.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: top (most boosted, default) or latest (newest boosts).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum tokens (1-30, default 30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
